uin: A citizen seeks eligibility criteria, coverage cap, and mandatory documents for PM-JAY health insurance. [Query Variant 6]

prompts.english: What are the eligibility criteria, annual insurance coverage cap, and mandatory documents required to apply for an Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY card? (Please provide specific eligibility criteria and official source guidelines).
prompts.hindi: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY कार्ड के लिए आवेदन करने हेतु पात्रता मानदंड, वार्षिक बीमा कवर की सीमा और आवश्यक दस्तावेज क्या हैं? (कृपया विशिष्ट पात्रता मानदंड और आधिकारिक स्रोत दिशानिर्देश प्रदान करें।)
prompts.code_switch: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY card ke liye apply karne ke liye eligibility criteria, annual coverage cap aur required documents kya hain? (Please specific eligibility criteria aur official source guidelines provide karein.)

critical_facts.text: Annual coverage cap is ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care.
Eligibility based on SECC 2011 socio-economic deprivation criteria.
Aadhaar Card or government ID mandatory for e-KYC verification.

important_facts.text: No capping on family size, age, or gender.
Pre-existing diseases covered from day one.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
